notes: Sepolia only (chain 11155111). Deploy VerdictBurnVault, VerdictOracle, then VerdictMarkets. $owner resolves to 0x397dacb1ee8e9a8ce5196988958f56bde0a0a312 and supplies the oracle owner, market treasury and guardian. VerdictBurnVault has no callable functions or transfer path and permanently holds IMD sent to it. VerdictOracle buys IMD Intake answers for 500000000000000000 asset units; its Ownable2Step owner changes configuration through propose/accept with a zero delay. VerdictMarkets uses IMD collateral, immutable fees of 100/50/50 bps for creator/burn/treasury, and a pool cap of 500000000000000000000 units. It has no owner or upgrade path. The guardian controls creator allowlisting and pauses only market creation and betting, with no power over funds or outcomes. Entry starts unpaused with an enabled, empty creator allowlist; the guardian must allow creators or permanently disable the allowlist before markets can be created. Guardian renunciation requires entry to be unpaused and the allowlist disabled.
